Actually, this brings up an interesting question. Can a Slave use the
Slave rule on himself?

Based on the Rulebook:

Slave: Some minions are identified as slaves to a specified clan. A
slave cannot take a directed action if his controller doesn’t control
a ready member of the specified clan. Also, if a member of the
specified clan controlled by the same Methuselah is blocked, the
controller can tap the slave to cancel the combat and to untap the
acting vampire and have the slave enter combat with the blocking
minion instead.

There is no clause that the slave has to be a different minion than
the acting vampire.

So, Pugfar Clan Impersonates to Tremere Antitribu. He also gets a
Zillah's Tears (or a Rutor's Hand or there's a CrimethInc. in play).

Pugfar plays a Bum's Rush on Queen Anne and Arika attempts to block.
Pugfar uses the Tears/Rutor's/CrimethInc. to untap, then taps himself
to invoke the Slave rule (on himself), so the block combat is
canceled, Pugfar is untapped, and he now enters combat with Arika (but
not as an acting minion so Obedience can't be used).

That seems to be a legal play, right? Of course it's a very cornercase
scenario and unlikely to be all that useful. But funny, nonetheless!
